title: Channel device lifecycle, compatibility and end-to-end testing
workflow: Register a supported device only after risk-appropriate customer authentication
Record device permissions, platform compatibility and version support
Authorize key banking journeys with institution and account object checks
Apply revoked-device and expired-session policies to subsequent commands
Test interrupted, duplicated and delayed channel callbacks in controlled environments
Review actual end-to-end results for money, privacy, accessibility and error recovery
invariants: A trusted device is not permanent authentication or payment authorization
Invalid app version may be restricted without changing customer account state
Device deregistration must revoke device-bound sessions
No production transaction is labeled passed from mocked test fixtures alone
End-to-end tests include backend permission and bank financial invariants
Client telemetry may not collect raw banking secrets or personal documents
A failed compatibility check must never silently bypass security controls
acceptance_tests: Revoked mobile session cannot initiate debit
Unsupported client receives safe upgrade response
Web/mobile retry same command does not duplicate posting
Accessibility and error-recovery flows verified on actual supported devices
independent_gate: Approved device and versioning policy, qualified security/QA test environment and real end-to-end evidence.
